classification.rationale: Heading 7606 covers aluminum plates, sheets and strip over 0.2 mm thick; the product is described as alloyed aluminum in cut-length sheet form, placing it under 7606.12 (alloys) rather than 7606.11 (not alloyed). Absent clad construction or identification of a specific heat-treatable alloy type, and absent a specified thickness confirming which sub-line applies, the default 'Other, not clad' residual statistical line 7606.12.30.96 is the best-supported code, consistent with NY N329891 and G82542. Because alloy type and precise thickness are not given, confidence is moderate rather than high.
